messages:
Sam (Support): FYI — AuroraHealth flagged a gap in the console: they need per-session trace links tied to billing records so their finance team can reconcile per-patient inference costs. They want CSV export and a dashboard tile. Ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3219>

Priya (PM): Thanks Sam. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Do they need every request tied to a single billing id, or an aggregated daily rollup? 2) Which models + regions are in scope? 3) Any residency/compliance constraints?

Sam (Support): Emily (sales) already chatted with them — they want per-request linkage for ~30% of requests (sampling) and a daily reconciliation CSV for finance. Models: mix of hosted and dedicated (gpt-3.8 family + a custom quantized model). Region: us-east + eu-west. Data residency: must not leave EU for eu-west customers.

Emily (Sales): Priority: high — this is blocking a PO for AuroraHealth (enterprise). They want rollout within Q2 if possible.

Mike (Eng): Implementation thoughts: MVP can be a) inject a stable trace_id header in the request path, b) persist trace_id -> billing_id mapping in telemetry pipeline, c) add a dashboard tile + CSV export. Risks: increases telemetry ingest volume (KV joins) and retention costs.

Mike (Eng): Example header we can surface to customers: `X-Redwood-Trace: <trace_id>` and store that alongside `request_id` and `model_version`. For CSV export a simple query:```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, billing_id, model_version, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_cents) as cost_cents
FROM inference_events
WHERE trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM sampled_requests WHERE customer_id = 'aurorahealth')
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
``` 

Priya (PM): Scope negotiation: propose MVP = sampled per-request linkage + daily CSV + a single dashboard tile that links to traces. Nice-to-have: per-route chargeback and per-model breakdowns in first rollout. Acceptance criteria: 1) CSV matches finance sample for 95% of rows, 2) tile shows per-day cost for last 30d, 3) EU customer data stored in eu-only region, 4) docs + integration test.

Maya (Ops): EU residency is non-negotiable for eu-west. We'll need to ensure telemetry pipeline respects partitioning and the CSV export job runs in-region. That adds ops work + infra config.

Mike (Eng): Rough estimate: platform + runtime changes to emit/store trace linkage = 2 devs * 3 weeks. Dashboard + CSV + docs = 1 dev + 1 designer * 2 weeks. EU partitioning ops work = 1 week. Total ~7 dev-weeks. Can tighten if we limit sampling to 10% for initial release.

Emily (Sales): If we can promise 10% sampling + CSV export by end of quarter, Aurora moves forward. Can we commit to that constraint?

Priya (PM): Proposal: ship 10% sampled linkage + daily CSV + tile for hosted models in us-east by end of Q2; EU + dedicated models in a follow-up sprint with ops support. Rollout plan: canary with 3 customers (Aurora, BetaMed, NovaThera) -> monitor cost delta and data fidelity.

Telemetry Bot: Current baseline: avg telemetry events/day = 2.1M, adding 10% sampled linkage estimated +200k events/day. Estimated monthly storage delta ~15GB.

Sam (Support): I'll sync with Aurora to confirm they accept 10% sampling for initial go. Adding to INC-3219 and will attach their sign-off once confirmed.

Priya (PM): Next steps: 1) Mike to write a tech design doc and list required schema changes (due EOW). 2) Maya to confirm EU partitioning checklist. 3) Emily to get Aurora sign-off on sampling. I'll create a PRD with acceptance criteria and link to the JIRA.

Mike (Eng): Will start a draft TD: `docs/td/trace-billing-linkage.md`. Quick note: consider TTL of mapping table — 90 days seems fine for finance reconciliation, but customers may request longer.

Emily (Sales): Finance asked about a one-time export for historical data (last 6 months). Can we surface that as a paid add-on?

Priya (PM): We'll treat historical bulk exports as an ops/paid feature (post-MVP). For the PRD I'll include a section for commercial add-ons.

Maya (Ops): Flagging: if Aurora asks for >90d retention for EU data, we need legal sign-off and potential storage SLA changes.

Sam (Support): noted, adding to INC-3219 conversation thread. :white_check_mark:

Priya (PM): Thanks team — I'll tag this as a candidate for the observability roadmap and slot it for prioritization in next planning meeting. :eyes:
